verdict.rationale: Runpod has a public pricing page at runpod.io/pricing and documented self-serve pricing: Pods are billed per second, Serverless is pay-per-second with no upfront costs, and billing is credit-based with no sales step. However, no evidence shows the page actually lists a published per-GPU-hour rate for each GPU type. Missing for 10: evidence of an itemized per-GPU-type hourly price table covering every GPU, and independent corroboration that prices are fully public without a sales conversation.
